neighboring_unit_entries.title: The outer-interval heuristic is conditional on Gram-block length
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The counted block types support the outer-first search for lengths two through five, but for lengths at least six the missing zeros increasingly move one interval inward; only one length-seven block places them in an outer interval. Thus an efficiency heuristic validated in common short blocks does not extrapolate uniformly to rarer long blocks.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Outer-interval priority is efficient because common short blocks support it, but block-type statistics reveal a qualitative location shift for longer blocks, motivating a length-conditioned search policy.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: This is solver- and range-specific empirical evidence, not a proof of a universal block-length law; exact table cells require scan verification.
